name: Timken India Limited
summary: Timken India Limited manufactures, sells, and distributes tapered and other roller bearings, components, accessories, and mechanical power transmission products in India, the United States, and internationally. The company offers engineered bearing products, such as mounted, roller, energy efficient, ball, precision, plain, thrust bearings, engineered seals, bearing accessories, and lubricant solutions, as well as bearing repair; grease lubrication and filtration systems; and sealing solution, oil, rail, automotive, and industrial seals.
